create_multi_turn_question: create an sgl function that defines a multi-turn conversation with system prompt and two user questions
run_multi_turn_question_stream: run the multi_turn_question sgl function with stream=True to stream generated answers
iterate_streamed_text: iterate over state.text_iter(var_name) to stream text output from a generated variable
async_stream_text: async iterate over state.text_async_iter(var_name) to stream text output asynchronously
set_openai_backend: set the default sgl backend to OpenAI with a specified model name
